t: Meet Federal Purchasing Requirements with Panduit Products - Panduit
s: The Buy American Act of 1933 (BAA) is a critical regulation that governs federal procurement processes. Generally speaking, the BAA requires that commercially-available-off-the-shelf (COTS) items be manufactured in the United States. While this description sounds pretty simple, there are stipulations around what qualifies a product to be compliant with BAA, so it isn’t as quite as simple as “Made in America.” · One stipulation is “cost of component testing.” Because Panduit products are considered commercially-available-off-the-shelf, we are exempt from cost of component testing.
